newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch in economic cooperation pact with Czechs.
newsitem.headline: Dutch in economic cooperation pact with Czechs.

text.p: Dutch Junior Minister of Economic Affairs Anneke van Dok has signed a cooperation pact with the Czech Republic, the Dutch ministry said on Friday.
The agreement, in which the Dutch ministry will invest four million guilders, will promote economic cooperation between companies from the two countries and an exchange of know-how.

It will focus on cooperation projects in the areas of agriculture, energy saving and environmental problems, technology and transport. The pact includes setting up a pilot project for a traffic management system in Prague.
The cooperation will also offer facilities to promote Czech exports and to increase the competitive power of Czech products on the European market.
Junior Minister Van Dok is currently visiting the Czech Republic where she is accompanied by representatives of Dutch companies.
